title: McFarlane DC Multiverse Hugo Strange as Batman Platinum 2024
descriptionText:
New in hand!

McFarlane DC Multiverse Hugo Strange as Batman, Platinum Edition (2024) action figure, from the BATMAN: TRANSFERENCE line. 1:10 scale, high-quality plastic construction, includes original packaging.

A great addition for DC Multiverse and Batman collectors. Manufactured in China, part of the McFarlane Toys DC Multiverse series.
